services.name: Campsite
services.desc: are based upon a family of 4, 2 Adults, 2 Children up to 13 years old, 1 non-electric vehicle, and 1 dog per night. Children 14 and older are considered adults. Extra fees apply for more than 2 adults or more than 2 children. Our rates include FREE Hot Showers in the bathhouse, Inground Swimming Pool, Playground, Rec-Hall with free games, Campground Wide WiFi, and access to the Ammonoosuc River. Holiday Rates in effect May 21-24, July 2-5, September 3-6, October 8-11. Nightly prices will vary depending upon days of the week (holidays), length of your stay, demand, or other factors. blurb: When was the last time you had an especially memorable camping experience? Maybe it goes all the way back to when you were a child, or maybe you are still waiting. Along the River Campground & Cabins invites you to try us out as your new special place.
